disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 核查了密钥读取面：全树无硬编码凭据；唯一密钥访问是主机端余额拉取（lib/index.js:476 从宿主凭据服务取 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY），密钥值只在主机进程内使用、不发给浏览器，文档（docs/install.md:5-7）明示该设计。预扫命中的 DSH-C01（对应 DG-R1-51）「凭据文件路径」字样位于安装文档说明行，经分析确认为良性：密钥仅用于向 DeepSeek 官方余额接口（lib/index.js:468、482-484）查询余额，属声明业务，未发生密钥外泄，不产生发现。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the credential reading surface: no hardcoded credentials anywhere in the tree; the only credential access is the host-side balance fetch (lib/index.js:476 retrieves DEEPSEEK_API_KEY from the host credential service), the key value is used only within the host process and is not sent to the browser, and the documentation (docs/install.md:5-7) explicitly states this design. The DSH-C01 (corresponding to DG-R1-51) "credential file path" hit from the pre-scan is located in the install documentation description line; after analysis it is confirmed benign: the key is used only to query the balance from the official DeepSeek balance endpoint (lib/index.js:468, 482-484), which is the declared purpose. No credential exfiltration occurred, no finding generated.

checked_items.zh: 检查了私钥、SSH 密钥、云厂商凭据文件、钱包助记词等敏感路径的读取代码，命中 0。
checked_items.en: Checked read code for sensitive paths such as private keys, SSH keys, cloud vendor credential files, and wallet mnemonics; 0 hits.

checked_items.en: Checked code for key enumeration commands (bulk key collection, cloud identity enumeration, wallet discovery); 0 hits.

evidence.zh: 核查了凭据读取与外联组合面：插件确实读取 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY 凭据（lib/index.js:476）且存在外呼（lib/index.js:482），但外呼目标为 DeepSeek 官方余额接口、凭据作为其官方用途的 Bearer 头，密钥值不离开主机进程，只把余额数字返回本地面板——不存在向第三方外泄凭据的通道，场景未成立。
evidence.en: Reviewed the credential-read plus outbound-combination surface: the plugin does read the DEEPSEEK_API_KEY credential (lib/index.js:476) and does make an outbound call (lib/index.js:482), but the call target is the official DeepSeek balance endpoint and the credential is used as the Bearer header for its official purpose; the key value does not leave the host process, only the balance number is returned to the local panel. There is no channel for exfiltrating the credential to a third party; the scenario does not hold.

checked_items.zh: 核查了工具注册面：插件未注册任何工具（全树无工具注册调用），不存在进入模型上下文的工具描述，投毒载体不存在。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the tool registration surface: the plugin registers no tools (no tool registration calls anywhere in the tree), so there are no tool descriptions entering the model context and no poisoning vector exists.

checked_items.zh: 核查了系统提示注入与消息面改写：未调用系统提示注入，未挂接任何模型请求/消息事件（如 pre-step、request 类），命中 0。
checked_items.en: Reviewed system prompt injection and message-surface rewriting: no system prompt injection calls, no hooks on any model request/message events (such as pre-step or request type); 0 hits.

checked_items.zh: 核查了 agent 指令文件面：全树无 SKILL.md、AGENTS.md、.claude/.cursor 等指令文件；README 与文档为普通说明文字，无指令覆写、伪造系统消息、诱导安装等措辞。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the agent instruction file surface: no instruction files such as SKILL.md, AGENTS.md, .claude/.cursor exist anywhere in the tree; the README and documentation are ordinary descriptive text with no wording that overrides instructions, forges system messages, or induces installation.

evidence.zh: 插件未注册任何工具、未注入任何系统提示段，没有工具描述或提示文本进入模型请求的载体，工具描述投毒面不存在。
evidence.en: The plugin registers no tools and injects no system prompt sections; there is no vector for tool descriptions or prompt text to enter model requests, so the tool-description poisoning surface does not exist.

evidence.en: The plugin has no tool descriptions or other prompt text; there is no wording surface that could induce the model to install plugins, rewrite configuration, or relax permissions. The code only registers an HTTP data route and one session projection unit.

checked_items.en: Found that the git count statistic concatenates the workspace subdirectory name into a bash loop command without escaping (lib/index.js:623-628, 639); if the directory name contains shell metacharacters, it can be interpreted and executed. See finding FND-001 for details.

evidence.en: Scanned all patch configs and YAML: cordis.patch.yml contains only one plugin insertion declaration (cordis.patch.yml:4-6), with no !!js executable scalars, so no code is evaluated in the host process.

evidence.zh: 未引用动态包执行工具，不存在把模型代码塞进宿主执行的面。

evidence.en: package.json has no install hooks or build scripts, and there are no executable carriers in the tree; the install documentation suggests installing via a git branch reference (docs/install.md:18), which is installation guidance for this plugin itself, not an execution surface that the plugin depends on.

evidence.en: The manifest declares a browser-side bundle (package.json:39-45); a dedicated check was performed on the bundle. lib/client.js only performs UI rendering and same-origin fetch (lib/client.js:158, 192), with no keyboard listeners, no clipboard access, and no credential calls.

evidence.zh: 未注册子代理提供方，不存在把轮次委派给进程外产品执行的面。
evidence.en: No sub-agent provider is registered; there is no surface for delegating turns to out-of-process products for execution.

evidence.en: No dsh native persistence mechanisms such as background tasks, scheduled reminders, or persistent goals are used, and there is no surface for listening to turn termination to stay alive.

checked_items.zh: 核查了外联面：全树唯一外呼是官方余额接口（lib/index.js:468 指向 https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance），其余网络调用均为浏览器同源 fetch（lib/client.js:158、192）。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the outbound connection surface: the only outbound call in the entire tree is to the official balance endpoint (lib/index.js:468 pointing to https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance); all other network calls are browser same-origin fetches (lib/client.js:158, 192).

checked_items.zh: 检查了编码外发、DNS/隧道、粘贴服务、AI 端点与代理劫持等隐蔽外泄通道，命中 0。

checked_items.zh: 检查了数据路由的同源防护：SSE 事件流端点做了同源校验（lib/index.js:149-158）；数据端点未做同源校验，但响应未携带浏览器跨源读取所需的许可头，且数据为本地状态与余额，未形成确定的外泄链。
checked_items.en: Checked same-origin protection for data routes: the SSE event stream endpoint performs same-origin validation (lib/index.js:149-158); the data endpoint does not perform same-origin validation, but its response does not carry the permission headers required for cross-origin browser reads, and the data is local state and balance, so no definitive exfiltration chain is formed.

evidence.zh: 未挂接模型请求路由事件、未注册自定义模型适配器，不存在运行时把对话重路由到任意端点的面。
evidence.en: No model request routing events are hooked and no custom model adapters are registered; there is no surface for re-routing conversations to arbitrary endpoints at runtime.

checked_items.en: Statically reviewed the runtime behavior surface: the plugin registers an HTTP prefix route (lib/index.js:140-142) and one session projection unit (lib/index.js:383-465), both of which are read-only data services; no runtime risk was found.

evidence.en: The plugin does not start its own web service or listen on a port; it only registers a prefix route on the host webServer (lib/index.js:140-142). The unauthenticated local RPC is an inherent host risk, not a service surface started by this plugin.

title.zh: git 计数命令拼接未转义工作区子目录名，目录名含 shell 元字符时可被解释执行
title.en: The git count command concatenation does not escape the workspace subdirectory name; if the directory name contains shell metacharacters, it can be interpreted and executed.

description.zh:
面板角标的未提交计数统计把会话工作区里带 .git 的子目录名直接拼进 bash 循环命令（lib/index.js:639），目录名中的 $()、反引号、分号等 shell 元字符会被解释执行。

触发面：面板打开或每 30 秒的角标轮询都会发起该命令构造（lib/index.js:216-217 走计数收集），子目录名来自对会话工作区的目录扫描（lib/index.js:623-628），只有含 .git 子目录的目录才会被纳入，且目录名未做任何转义。

位置：lib/index.js:616-655 的计数统计逻辑；同文件对关注仓库路径做了单引号转义（lib/index.js:636），此处遗漏。
description.en:
The uncommitted-count badge on the panel concatenates subdirectory names containing .git in the session workspace directly into a bash loop command (lib/index.js:639); shell metacharacters such as $(), backticks, and semicolons in the directory name are interpreted and executed.

Trigger surface: opening the panel or the 30-second badge poll initiates this command construction (lib/index.js:216-217 goes through count collection). Subdirectory names come from a directory scan of the session workspace (lib/index.js:623-628); only directories containing a .git subdirectory are included, and the directory name is not escaped in any way.

Location: the count statistic logic at lib/index.js:616-655; the same file escapes watched repository paths with single quotes (lib/index.js:636), but this spot misses it.

impact.zh:
后果：当会话工作区含一个名称带 shell 元字符（如 $()、反引号、分号）的 git 子仓库目录时，HUD 角标轮询会把该名称当命令解释，在宿主 shell 服务上下文执行任意命令，无需用户或模型显式触发。

触发条件：需要用户在当前会话工作区放置或克隆一个目录名含 shell 元字符且带 .git 的嵌套仓库（例如被投毒的仓库含此类子模块），随后任一次 HUD 角标刷新即触发。

定级依据：属真实可达的代码缺陷（外部文件系统输入未转义直达 shell 执行点），正常使用条件下即可被特定目录名触发，但无恶意意图证据、触发依赖特定目录命名，按定级纪律定 MEDIUM，置信度 medium（单一静态手段检出，无动态证据）。
impact.en:
Impact: when the session workspace contains a git subrepository directory whose name contains shell metacharacters (such as $(), backticks, or semicolons), the HUD badge poll interprets that name as a command and executes arbitrary commands in the host shell service context, without requiring explicit user or model action.

Trigger condition: the user must place or clone a nested repository in the current session workspace whose directory name contains shell metacharacters and has a .git (for example, a poisoned repository containing such a submodule); then any HUD badge refresh triggers it.

Severity rationale: this is a genuinely reachable code defect (unescaped external filesystem input reaches a shell execution point), triggerable under normal usage by a specific directory name, but there is no evidence of malicious intent and triggering depends on specific directory naming. Per severity discipline, rated MEDIUM, confidence medium (detected by a single static method, no dynamic evidence).

summary.zh: 核验了插件清单与元数据：id、版本、commit 与任务卡一致，bundle 与 client 声明齐全，作者与仓库无伪造痕迹。

summary.en: Performed a static scan of all source code, configuration, and documentation: apart from one git command concatenation flaw (see FND-001), there are no malicious patterns such as eval, subprocess, or download-and-execute; the credential path string in the documentation was analyzed to be a benign balance feature.

summary.en: Behavior surface analysis: no install hooks, no obfuscated or encoded payloads, no covert outbound connections; the only outbound call is to the official DeepSeek balance endpoint, and the key never leaves the host.

summary.zh: AI 元数据与提示面审查：插件未注册工具、未注入系统提示、无指令类文件，模型上下文无投毒载体。
summary.en: AI metadata and prompt surface review: the plugin registers no tools, injects no system prompts, has no instruction-type files, and the model context has no poisoning vector.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（无沙箱产物）。

limits.en:

Capability declaration: package.json's dsh.bundle does not explicitly declare capability fields; declared_capabilities are inferred from actual code measurement (online balance query, executing git commands via the host shell, read-only file access, and directory watching).

Dynamic sandbox not enabled (DG-L4 = na); runtime behavior was only statically reviewed.
